llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must wrap the form screen with `KeyboardProvider` and render form content in `KeyboardAwareScrollView` from `react-native-keyboard-controller`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Uses `KeyboardController` (the module default export) as a wrapper and `Animated.ScrollView` instead of `KeyboardProvider` and `KeyboardAwareScrollView` from react-native-keyboard-controller.
`KeyboardAwareScrollView` is not used; the `Animated.ScrollView` present does not set `keyboardDismissMode="interactive"`.
`keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"` is set on `Animated.ScrollView`, not on a `KeyboardAwareScrollView` as required.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use `useReanimatedKeyboardAnimation` with Reanimated `useAnimatedStyle` to drive footer `translateY` from `-keyboard.height.value`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Uses a custom `keyboardHeight` shared value populated via `KeyboardController.addListener` instead of `useReanimatedKeyboardAnimation`; does not drive translateY from `-keyboard.height.value` as required.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use Reanimated `interpolate` over `keyboard.progress.value` to animate footer bottom padding during keyboard transitions.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No use of `useReanimatedKeyboardAnimation`, `keyboard.progress.value`, or `interpolate` anywhere in the file; footer padding is static.
